title: Success Leaves Clues
coreMove: Study a strong outcome for transferable patterns while refusing to copy its surface costume.
sourcePressure: Chapter 3 says successful outcomes leave studyable patterns, while warning against copying every surface detail or treating success as magic.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Imitating successful people detail for detail or turning winners into proof of certainty.

hook: A single choice changes the whole day
The real priority is hiding under the busy work
Success Leaves Clues as a generic focus opener
counterintuition: Focus is harder than it looks
tryThisNow: Set a timer and list priorities
Write down your one thing without a concrete context
examples: generic office worker choosing email or strategy

exampleSpecs.domain: youth soccer academy studying a rival club
exampleSpecs.stakes: parents demand copying uniforms and slogans
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the director points from the rival's trophy photo to their documented passing drill frequency and rejects the uniform copy
exampleSpecs.firstImage: two club photos taped beside a practice log with pass counts circled

exampleSpecs.domain: restaurant prep line after a competitor wins reviews
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she ignores the competitor's tile color and times their ticket flow from counter to pickup, then changes her own prep stations
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a stopwatch running beside a stack of takeout tickets

exampleSpecs.stakes: grant renewal depends on attendance recovery
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: he reviews the neighboring branch and finds the clue is parent pickup timing, not their superhero theme
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a library sign-up sheet folded around a school dismissal schedule

exampleSpecs.domain: manufacturing line copying a safety record
exampleSpecs.stakes: injury rate threatens an insurance audit
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she traces the safer plant's near-miss review habit instead of buying the same poster set
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a clipboard of near-miss notes beside unopened safety posters

exampleSpecs.stakes: sponsors may cancel after flat downloads
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the producer predicts guests drive growth, then finds episode retention jumps instead at one recurring story segment
exampleSpecs.firstImage: retention graph printed with one segment shaded in pencil

exampleSpecs.domain: tailoring shop learning from a master fitter
exampleSpecs.stakes: a wedding suit must be corrected by Friday
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the apprentice stops copying the master's patter and marks how she checks shoulder slope before sleeve length
exampleSpecs.firstImage: chalk dust on navy wool under a brass measuring gauge

skillTargets: test whether a clue transfers to your setting

tryThisNowSpec: Pick one result you admire and list one mechanism behind it, not the person's schedule, brand, or personality.
